commands.command: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; O=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); case "$O" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin; test "$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)" = main; git -C "$P" merge --ff-only origin/main; test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main)"

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; WT=$(git -C "$P" worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's#^branch refs/heads/##p'); printf '%s\n' '=== DELETE BRANCHES MERGED INTO MAIN ==='; for b in $(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads); do test "$b" = main && continue; if printf '%s\n' "$WT" | grep -Fxq "$b"; then echo "KEEP_WORKTREE $b"; continue; fi; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$b" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then git -C "$P" branch -d "$b"; else echo "KEEP_NOT_IN_MAIN $b"; fi; done
commands.output:
=== DELETE BRANCHES MERGED INTO MAIN ===
KEEP_NOT_IN_MAIN agent-control
KEEP_NOT_IN_MAIN gh-pages
Deleted branch mvp/environment-controller (was 06bec4f1).

commands.command: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; WT=$(git -C "$P" worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's#^branch refs/heads/##p'); printf '%s\n' '=== DELETE REDUNDANT LOCAL TRACKING COPIES ==='; for b in agent-control gh-pages; do if ! git -C "$P" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$b"; then echo "ABSENT_LOCAL $b"; continue; fi; if printf '%s\n' "$WT" | grep -Fxq "$b"; then echo "KEEP_WORKTREE $b"; continue; fi; if ! git -C "$P" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$b"; then echo "KEEP_NO_REMOTE $b"; continue; fi; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$b" "origin/$b"; then echo "DELETE_REDUNDANT_LOCAL $b"; git -C "$P" branch -D "$b"; else echo "KEEP_LOCAL_UNPUSHED $b"; fi; done
